1.consolidated_definition: Planta herbácea perenne oriunda de Brasil, de hasta 1 m de altura, de hojas carnosas y flores de color amarillo anaranjado; se usa en jardinería como ornamental. Crassulaceae Kalanchoe brasilensis.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Perennial herbaceous plant native to Brazil, growing up to 1 m in height, with fleshy leaves and yellow-orange flowers; used in horticulture as an ornamental. Family Crassulaceae Kalanchoe brasilensis.
